Reference

Source: vignettes/function_reference/index.Rmd
index.Rmd
Function Description
compute_distances() Compute pairwise feature distances from a selected AnnData layer.
spatial_silhouette_analysis() Score combinations of neighborhood size and number of clusters using a spatial silhouette score.
spatial_constrained_hac() Partition a tissue sample into spatially constrained clusters with constrained agglomerative hierarchical clustering.
create_blocks() Create permutation blocks within each cluster for block-based testing.
multiple_comparison() Pairwise MMD² comparison between all clusters, with multiple-testing correction.
plot_spatial_clusters() Plot the tissue colored by assigned cluster labels.
plot_cluster_feature_presence() Plot each cluster alongside its most defining features.
pairwise_results_to_matrix() Build a cluster similarity matrix and network plot from MMD² results.

All user-facing repspat functions, called from R via reticulate in the workshop vignettes.
